overview.heading: Room to live, work and unwind
paragraphs: Desert Sage Suites Phoenix Mesa is an all-suite, extended-stay hotel designed for travelers who need more than a room. Every suite features a fully equipped kitchen, a dedicated living area with a sofa and work space, and a bedroom that stays quiet behind its own door.

Start each morning with our complimentary hot breakfast, cool off in the heated outdoor pool, shoot hoops on the sport court, or fire up the courtyard grills in the evening. Pets are welcome, parking and Wi-Fi are free, and our grocery delivery service keeps your kitchen stocked while you're out.
Downtown Mesa, Cactus League spring training ballparks, Arizona State University and the Phoenix–Mesa Gateway and Sky Harbor airports are all part of the neighborhood we call home.
overview.imageAlt: Suite living area with open kitchen

rooms.heading: Suites & Rooms
rooms.intro: Every suite comes with a full kitchen, separate living and sleeping areas, free Wi-Fi and plenty of natural light. Choose the layout that fits your stay.

items.name: Studio Suite, 1 King
items.shortDescription: An open-plan suite with a king bed, full kitchen and a comfortable work-and-lounge area.
items.description: Our most popular layout for solo travelers and couples. The studio pairs a plush king bed with a full kitchen, a dining counter for two and a sofa lounge beneath the window. Blackout drapes, a large desk with outlets and a 55-inch smart TV make it as easy to work as it is to relax.
features: Full kitchen with dishwasher, stovetop & full-size refrigerator

items.name: Studio Suite, 2 Queens
items.shortDescription: Two queen beds, a full kitchen and a lounge nook — ideal for friends, teammates or a small family.
items.description: Designed for groups that want to share one suite without giving up space. Two queen beds sit opposite a full kitchen and dining area, with a sofa and smart TV between them. Great for spring-training trips, youth-sports weekends and relocating families.

items.name: One-Bedroom Suite, 1 King
items.shortDescription: A private bedroom plus a separate living room with sofa bed, dining area and full kitchen.
items.description: Close the bedroom door and the living room becomes an office, a playroom or a second bedroom. The one-bedroom suite includes a king bed, a queen sofa bed, two smart TVs, a dining table and a full kitchen — the right fit for longer stays and traveling families.
features: Living room with queen sofa bed

items.name: Two-Bedroom Suite, 2 Kings
items.shortDescription: Two private bedrooms, two bathrooms and a shared living room and kitchen — our largest suite.
items.description: Our two-bedroom suite gives everyone their own space: two bedrooms, each with a king bed and private bathroom, open onto a shared living room, dining area and full kitchen. Perfect for families, colleagues sharing an assignment, or an extended stay with visitors.
features: Two private bedrooms, each with a king bed
Living room with queen sofa bed

items.name: Accessible Studio Suite, 1 King
items.shortDescription: Mobility-accessible studio with a roll-in shower, lowered counters and wider doorways.
items.description: This studio suite is designed for mobility accessibility, with a roll-in shower with grab bars and a fold-down bench, lowered kitchen counters, accessible-height bed and wider doorways. Visual and audible alarm kits are available on request.

amenities.heading: Hotel Amenities
amenities.intro: Everything you need for a night, a week or a season — included with your stay unless noted.

featured.title: Heated Outdoor Pool
featured.text: Swim year-round in our heated courtyard pool, surrounded by loungers, shade sails and a sun deck.

featured.title: Free Hot Breakfast
featured.text: Eggs, breakfast meats, waffles, fresh fruit, yogurt and coffee served every morning in the breakfast room.

featured.title: Sport Court
featured.text: Lit outdoor court for basketball and pickleball. Equipment is available at the front desk.

featured.title: 24-Hour Fitness Center
featured.text: Cardio machines, free weights and stretching space, open around the clock.

featured.title: Pet Friendly
featured.text: Dogs and cats are welcome for a non-refundable pet fee. A pet-relief area sits just past the sport court.

featured.title: Guest Laundry
featured.text: Washers and dryers on site, plus same-day dry cleaning drop-off Monday through Friday.

categories.name: In Every Suite
items: Full kitchen with full-size refrigerator, stovetop, microwave & dishwasher

categories.name: Business & Meetings
items: Meeting room for up to 24 guests
Package receiving at the front desk

policies.title: Pet Policy
policies.text: Dogs and cats are welcome. A non-refundable pet fee applies per stay; please contact the hotel for the current fee and any weight limits. Pets must be leashed in public areas and may not be left unattended in suites.

policies.title: Parking
policies.text: Complimentary self-parking for registered guests, including space for oversized vehicles and trailers. Electric-vehicle charging is available on a first-come basis.

policies.title: Smoke-Free
policies.text: The entire property, including suites, balconies and the pool deck, is smoke-free. A cleaning fee applies to any violation.

dining.heading: Dining
dining.intro: Start the day with a hot breakfast, stock your kitchen with our grocery service and join us for evening socials in the courtyard.

items.name: Complimentary Hot Breakfast
items.description: A rotating hot buffet with scrambled eggs, breakfast meats, waffles, oatmeal, fresh fruit, yogurt, pastries, juices and fresh-brewed coffee. Gluten-free and plant-based options are available daily.

items.name: Evening Courtyard Social
items.description: Light bites, salads and local craft beverages served poolside three evenings a week. Fire up the grills, meet fellow guests and let the kids run on the sport court.

items.name: The Market
items.description: Grab-and-go meals, snacks, frozen entrées, beverages and pantry basics next to the front desk, around the clock.

items.name: Grocery Delivery Service
items.hours: Order by 10 AM for same-day delivery, Mon–Sat
items.description: Hand your shopping list to the front desk and we'll have your groceries delivered to your suite while you're out. You pay only for the groceries.

area.heading: Explore Mesa & the East Valley
area.intro: Spring-training ballparks, desert trails, downtown arts and two airports are all close by. Distances are left blank in this demo so you can enter accurate ones for your property.

attractions.name: Sloan Park
attractions.description: Spring-training home of the Chicago Cubs, hosting Cactus League games each February and March.

attractions.name: Mesa Arts Center
attractions.description: Downtown Mesa's performing- and visual-arts complex with theaters, galleries and working studios.

attractions.name: Arizona Museum of Natural History
attractions.description: Mesa's natural-history museum, known for its dinosaur exhibits and Southwest archaeology collections.

attractions.name: i.d.e.a. Museum
attractions.description: A hands-on children's museum in downtown Mesa centered on art, imagination and creative play.

attractions.name: Usery Mountain Regional Park
attractions.description: Maricopa County park at the edge of the Tonto National Forest with hiking and mountain-biking trails, including the Wind Cave Trail.

attractions.name: Lost Dutchman State Park
attractions.description: State park at the base of the Superstition Mountains in Apache Junction, with trails and sweeping desert views.

attractions.name: Saguaro Lake
attractions.description: Reservoir on the Salt River in the Tonto National Forest, popular for boating, fishing and kayaking.

attractions.name: Downtown Mesa
attractions.description: Main Street's restaurants, shops, public art and the Valley Metro light-rail line.

attractions.name: Mesa Riverview
attractions.description: Open-air shopping and dining center next to Sloan Park and Riverview Park.

attractions.name: Superstition Springs Center
attractions.description: Enclosed shopping mall in east Mesa with department stores and dining.

attractions.name: Golfland Sunsplash
attractions.description: Water park, miniature golf and arcade in Mesa — a summer favorite for families.

attractions.name: Arizona Commemorative Air Force Museum
attractions.description: Aviation museum at Falcon Field with a collection of historic military aircraft.

attractions.name: Las Sendas Golf Club
attractions.description: Golf course in northeast Mesa with Sonoran Desert and mountain views.

attractions.name: Arizona State University
attractions.description: ASU's Polytechnic campus is in Mesa, and the main Tempe campus and Mill Avenue district are in neighboring Tempe.

attractions.name: Arizona Day Trips
attractions.description: The Apache Trail, Tonto National Forest and the Sonoran Desert are all within reach for a day on the road.

airports.name: Phoenix–Mesa Gateway Airport
airports.note: Mesa's commercial airport, served by several low-cost carriers.

airports.name: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport
airports.note: The Phoenix metro's main international airport.

transport.name: Valley Metro Light Rail
transport.note: Serves downtown Mesa along Main Street, continuing to Tempe and Phoenix.

items.name: Maria G.
items.title: Perfect for spring training
items.text: We stayed ten nights for Cactus League games. The one-bedroom suite had everything — a real kitchen, a quiet bedroom and a sofa for the kids. Breakfast was hot and fast every morning.

items.name: Devin R.
items.title: Six-week work assignment, zero complaints
items.text: The desk setup and Wi-Fi made working from the suite easy, and the grocery delivery service meant I never had to leave after a long day. Pool was warm even in February.

items.name: The Patel Family
items.title: Great space for a family of five
items.text: Two-bedroom suite was huge. Kids loved the sport court and the evening social. Only wish the pool deck had a few more loungers on busy weekends.

items.name: Lauren K.
items.title: Dog-friendly and actually meant it
items.text: Staff greeted our lab by name on day two. The relief area is handy and there are good walking routes nearby. Clean, quiet and the kitchen was fully stocked with cookware.

items.name: Carlos M.
items.title: Solid extended-stay option in Mesa
items.text: Stayed three weeks while relocating. Weekly housekeeping, laundry on site and free parking for my trailer. Breakfast gets busy around 8 but the staff keep it stocked.

items.name: Jenna & Tom
items.title: Our winter escape
items.text: Spent a month here escaping the snow. Heated pool every morning, grills every evening, and the Superstition Mountains for weekend hikes. Already booked next year.
